_comment: Target channel layout per NVR for rearrange.py. Keys are NVR names (must match config.json). Inside each NVR, keys are 1-based channel numbers. ip = camera to bind, lens = lens/stream index (0 for single-lens), title = on-screen name. The camera must already be registered on that NVR. IPs are RFC5737 documentation ranges -- replace with yours.
